summary: Reconciled the 30 retained Story 18.4 task IDs with the accepted first-batch bootstrap plan: authorization-only Web validates a grant without October data, generator prepare alone migrates a freshly owned empty target and creates its first batch, and selected-data modes bind only an exact existing batch.

finding_dispositions.IA-18.4-BOOTSTRAP-01: T006/T007 establish an authorization-only Web composition from existing ordinary Identity/Data Protection, management authority and deployment target/certificate allowlists, exposing only grant issuance/validation and registering/opening/migrating no October context or selected-data/source-approval service. T003/T016/T017 distinguish first-batch PrepareAsync from existing-batch BindAsync. T018/T019 require live grant validation and read-only connected target identity before generator prepare alone migrates and atomically creates the first batch; select and selected-data Web require an existing exact batch and never migrate. T020/T029 require positive fresh-empty first-batch and negative forged/absent-authority empty/unmigrated target qualification, plus A/B isolation and ordinary startup checks. Dependencies now state this order explicitly.

self_review.task_order_and_coverage: All existing T001-T030 IDs and four user-story phases remain. T012/T013 use a controlled exact existing-batch selection for source-approval route tests before actual selected-data host startup; no production batch is preseeded or bypassed. Every accepted R/I/S/A/F/L/T design ID remains on a checklist line.
self_review.verification_route: SelfContained T018 supplies honest RED for missing host composition without external resources. After GREEN, T020/T029 perform direct actual-process/PostgreSQL/certificate qualification only on root-established authorized owned targets; no fabricated RED or another story's database/credentials are assumed.
self_review.scope_and_authority: The correction uses the accepted two-route bootstrap and four-route selected-data boundary, exact batch isolation, Story 18.1 source contracts, provider/context and ordinary-startup constraints. No new Worker tool, Scan strategy, Knowledge/Chat work, implementation approval or resource permission is inferred.
self_review.project_lesson_precaution: Callable bootstrap/selector/issuer seams remain explicit under the Story 18.1 public-seam lesson. Fresh owned PostgreSQL checks retain fixed history-schema placement, full post-approval schema proof, suite inventory and cleanup requirements.
